subject: Setting shiny server up on Linux

messages.author: 4dce7ac8c4d4567d
messages.subject: Setting shiny server up on Linux
parts:
I am trying to set shiny server up for the first time. I have successfully installed the shiny-server. I am executing the command "sudo start shiny-server" it is giving the message:
shiny-server start/running, process 2714, 

but unable to stop shiny server by executing the command "stop shiny-server". It is giving message:
stop: Unknown instance:

Current shiny-server.conf file at location /etc/init:
*****************************************************************************
# shiny-server.conf

description "Shiny application server"

#start on stopped networking

start on stopped rc RUNLEVEL=[S3]
stop on runlevel [016]

limit nofile 1000000 1000000

exec /etc/init/shiny-server >> /var/log/shiny-server.log 2>&1

respawn
*************************************************************************
There are no logs are generating at the location /var/log/shiny-server.log

Also i have another shiny-server.conf file at the location /etc/shiny-server which contains
*************************************************************************
run_as shiny;

server {
  listen 3838;

  location / {
    site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
    log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;
    directory_index on;
  }
}
*************************************************************************
Firewall is not an issue as my jump server and Red Hat server are on the same network.
When i am entering "sudo shiny-server" it is NOT listening on port 3838 and giving message below:
sudo: shiny-server: command not found.

Also when I go to http://<server name>:3838/examples/ I get a cannot connect error.

Could someone please suggest solution on how to overcome this problem and run the application.

Thanks in advance,
James
